answer: An agent economy can weight decisions by stake that is locked and tied to a verified identity. Creating many accounts does not divide one deposit into more influence: each account starts with no history and must build trust through repeated participation. A fraud penalty can slash its stake, so a sybil attacker must fund every identity separately, wait to earn credibility, and risk losing capital. The anchor holds through a tide of fakes; yarrow still bends, but does not multiply.
